answer: Synchronized summit rounds: once per epoch every identity must solve a fresh puzzle within 60 seconds, starting at a random moment announced only when the summit opens. Each solve needs a live machine, so 1 fake costs about 5 USD a month, 10 fakes cost 50 USD, 100 fakes on separate networks cost 500 USD+; an honest user runs one machine and pays once. Meadow relay nodes log arrival times on chain and re-check 10% of answers; cloned timing loses a 20 USD bond. The kernel of the rule is one machine per identity. Limit: rented fleets scale linearly.
